title: Generator Orchestra
text: Your neighbour's tiger gen starts rattling violently at 6:00 AM. Sleep has flown away.

choices.label: Endure the sound and wake up early

success.text: You rise tired, but up before the sun.
Sweet silence restored. Catch small extra sleep.

title: Sudden Delta Downpour
text: Heavy tropical rain starts pouring out of nowhere! Water flooding street gutters.

choices.label: Take shelter under a shop awning

success.text: Stayed dry while having friendly gist with other stranded people.

choices.label: Rush into a passing keke (₦400 surge)

success.text: Saved your clothes, paid rain surge fare.

title: Celebration Suya Tasting
text: Mallam Abdullahi at the night spot is celebrating a new child and sharing hot beef suya to regulars.

choices.label: Congratulate him and accept delicious spicy suya

success.text: Spicy, tender, well-seasoned! Hunger erased and spirit uplifted.

title: Dropped Purse on the Pathway
text: You spot a dropped purse on the floor near the spice stalls with ₦2,000 cash and an ID card.

choices.label: Call out the name on ID and return it to the owner

success.text: The woman prays for you and gifts you ₦500 blessing reward. Respect in market went up!
You gain the ₦2,000, but feel a wave of guilty conscience.

title: Wazobia FM Live Caller Gist
text: You tune in to Wazobia FM and hear funny relationship debate on live radio.

choices.label: Laugh out loud and enjoy the program

success.text: Warri humor never fails. Laughter recharges the soul.

title: Distress Sales Clearance
text: A trader closing his stall early offers you a wholesale batch of power cables for cheap (₦1,000).

success.text: Flipped the cables in 15 minutes for ₦2,400 total! Quick ₦1,400 profit.

fail.text: Two cables were faulty. You only recovered ₦800.

success.text: You keep moving. No risk taken.

title: Acrobatic Street Dancers
text: A youth dance crew is practicing amazing Afro-fusion dance stunts in the park open square.

success.text: The energy was infectious! Mood fully refreshed.
They shouted your praise! 'Boss levels! Respect!'

title: Network Provider Promo Bonus
text: A flash SMS arrives: You have been awarded 500MB bonus data for active SIM usage.

success.text: Bonus active! Browsing feels sweeter when it's free.
